referenceDna.annotatedDescription: The direct ADE Auto Repairs website in London, England uses white editorial repair statement with a strong red action. Navigation is minimal utility menu with direct phone access. Its page moves through editorial opening, vehicle scope ribbon, service grid, why choose explanation, process steps, customer proof, work gallery, visit and contact, with many repair tasks indexed in a dense but orderly grid. genuine car-repair and shop pictures balanced with whitespace. Transferable mechanics are serif repair promise, service index grid, work-image gallery. The brand identity, people, photographs, reviews, wording and business claims remain source-only.
